displayDescription: A sketched bulb draws in, wires grow out of it and hatched nodes pop on, all boiling through three held Rough.js drawings on cool newsprint.
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (window.__timelines.video, sole time owner)
Motion interpolate (maps shared timeline time to per-element progress)
limitations: Boil drawings are Rough.js seeded variants (seeds n, n+101, n+202) of the same geometry rather than hand-drawn redraws; silhouettes and positions stay locked.
Ink and paper are approximated procedurally: one flat ink colour and a seeded, static grain layer. There is no simulated ink bleed or paper fibre.
BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json reports 0 matched sources and no contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied. The cool newsprint background is a scene choice, not source evidence.
STYLE.json tech.preview_recipes is absent and the supplied recipe list is empty, so the preview demonstrates the primary line-boil style.
Lettering is DOM text in system typography and does not boil, so glyphs stay readable. Only the line art boils.
No Blender was used, as the user instructed.
